purpose: Live accuracy gate for the Present/Partial/Absent verdict step. This SUPERSEDES the 20-fixture construction-rule set. It is designed to scale to all 99 ZMS criteria and to accept HUMAN-VALIDATED and EXPERT-PANEL labels, which carry more evidential weight than construction-rule labels. The gate runs IN the pipeline and ENFORCES a minimum accuracy threshold.

label_source_tiers.expert_panel: Verdict agreed by >=2 senior Salesforce SAs on a real SDD excerpt. Strongest.
label_source_tiers.human_validated: Verdict assigned/confirmed by one senior SA. Strong.
label_source_tiers.construction_rule: Verdict follows by construction from the playbook discriminators. Weakest; clear-cut cases only, does not exercise borderline judgment.
label_source_tiers.sa_exemplar: Verdict on a passage drawn from an SDD an SA graded best-in-class. The SA endorsed the DOCUMENT; the criterion-level Present mapping was inferred by matching the verbatim passage to the ZMS depth_indicator. Stronger than construction_rule (real SDD prose, real Present examples) but NOT a human per-criterion verdict, so it does NOT count toward the human_validated fraction that unlocks blocking authority.

gate_policy.note: If fewer than min_cases_for_enforcement labeled cases exist, the gate runs in ADVISORY mode (reports accuracy but does not block) and the diagnostic report must carry a calibration-coverage caveat. Full enforcement (blocking) requires >= min_cases_for_enforcement cases AND at least min_human_validated_fraction human/expert labels, so the gate's authority scales with the quality of the validation data, not just its size. sa_exemplar cases count toward measured accuracy, per-class recall, and coverage, but NOT toward min_human_validated_fraction_for_full_authority — blocking still requires real SA per-criterion labels.
